Combined therapy with triptorelin, which suppressed testosterone secretion by inhibiting the pitui- tary-gonadal axis, and supportive psychotherapy, has been tried in the treatment of men with paraphilias (see p.954): a reduction in abnormal sexual thoughts and behaviours has been reported, although the study was uncontrolled.1 1. Gonadorelin analogues are effective in the management of endometriosis (p.2091), but the need for long- term therapy to prevent recurrence limits their value because of the risk of osteoporosis; ‘add-back’ therapy (hormone replace- ment) can be used to prevent this.
